shortVowels.scope: Conservative review-only recuts for rejected short-vowel candidates. Approved clips and runtime mappings are unchanged.
shortVowels.method: Owner listening notes were matched against 2.5–10 ms waveform energy, stop closures, frication changes, and repeated log-spectrum transitions. Proposed ends stop before the following consonant becomes audible; the one proposed start moves back to the consonant closure/onset rather than the following vowel onset.

repairs.evidence: The target vowel remains energetic through about 7.83. A sharp energy collapse starts at 7.84 and continues into the next ب closure; the old end at 7.90 reaches the following burst/vowel transition.
repairs.caveat: Verify that 7.835 retains the natural tail of بَ without the next bilabial closure.

repairs.evidence: The old start is the strong vowel/burst transition at 8.17, after the final ب closure has begun. Spectral change and falling energy around 8.105–8.11 mark the preceding consonant onset, so moving the start earlier restores the whole stop.
repairs.caveat: The added closure overlaps the end of the separately approved بِ clip; review this recut independently for a clean voiced ب rather than پ-like onset.

repairs.evidence: The first vowel decays into a near-silent stop closure from roughly 9.09 to 9.145. The following ت release begins after 9.145 and reaches its vowel transition near the old 9.20 end, explaining why the owner heard the next syllable.
repairs.caveat: The source consonant was sometimes recognized as د; verify the initial dental stop as well as the new end.

repairs.evidence: The first جَ vowel stays strong through 11.61. At 11.615 energy drops abruptly into sustained affrication for the next ج; the old 11.695 end includes that following consonant onset.
repairs.caveat: Review for a natural vowel tail; the following affricate begins immediately after the proposed edge.

repairs.evidence: A distinct breathy/pharyngeal transition for the following ح begins around 13.25, with further strong changes at 13.32 and the next vowel onset at 13.375. Trimming before 13.25 removes the following /ha/ material identified by the owner.
repairs.caveat: This becomes a short clip; verify that the target حِ consonant is still complete at the existing start.

repairs.evidence: The waveform begins its transition into the next repeated د around 14.25: energy falls from the preceding vowel and reaches a local low before the old 14.275 boundary. The owner hearing a final /d/ matches this included next onset.
repairs.caveat: The consonant boundary is less silent than the ب and ت cases; verify that 14.25 removes the final /d/ without clipping the vowel.

repairs.evidence: The first vowel remains stable through about 18.74. Energy and spectral shape then fall/change from 18.75 toward the next ز onset; the old edge at 18.795 includes enough following frication for the owner to hear a final /z/.
repairs.caveat: Verify the new end during owner review because voiced frication has no full silent closure.

repairs.evidence: The target vowel/fricative body continues through roughly 19.09. A repeated spectral transition begins around 19.10–19.13 for the following ز, while 19.19 is its strong vowel onset; ending at 19.10 removes the audible final /z/ reported by the owner.
repairs.caveat: The start is preserved because the owner already heard the intended initial زِ; only the next consonant is removed.

repairs.evidence: The first vowel/fricative body is stable through about 20.10. Energy then drops sharply from 20.11 into the following س transition, reaching a local minimum near 20.14; the old end includes this next fricative onset.
repairs.caveat: Verify that the shortened edge keeps a natural سَ release without the next /s/.

repairs.evidence: The target stays stable through about 21.46. Energy falls rapidly from 21.47 into the next ش onset and bottoms near 21.49; the old 21.50 end crosses that transition, producing the extra consonantal sound noted by the owner.
repairs.caveat: The owner described the extra consonant as /j/ rather than /sh/; confirm that trimming at 21.475 resolves it.

notProposed.reason: Owner notes indicate a source pronunciation/vowel mismatch, a merged multi-syllable utterance, or a consonant identity problem that cannot be repaired confidently by a conservative boundary move alone.

The old clip starts at the vowel transition after the consonant onset, but the required earlier onset overlaps the rejected زِ region and the source realization was heard as دُ; a clean boundary-only repair is not defensible.

tanween.scope: Conservative repair analysis for owner-rejected TANWEEN candidates in batch-1, 39.00–65.30 seconds. Correct/approved items are intentionally omitted.

repairs.specificEvidence: Full-source ASR recognizes تان for the target. Spectral novelty and rising energy place the next ت onset at 41.035–41.067 seconds; ending 20 ms before that onset retains the target nasal tail while removing the added consonant.

Full-source ASR recognizes ثان, then begins the following ح utterance at about 42.40 seconds. The owner hears an added h-like consonant. The proposed end is 20 ms before the low-energy fricative onset, preserving the preceding nasal ending.

Full-source ASR recognizes consecutive زان utterances. The next same-consonant onset produces a spectral-flux rise centered at 49.885 seconds; the old cut crosses it, matching the owner's added-z report. The new end precedes that onset by 25 ms.

Full-source ASR recognizes consecutive شان utterances. A strong spectral onset at 51.637–51.640 seconds marks the next ش; the old cut includes it. Ending just before that onset removes the added consonant without stripping the target nasal tail.

The old cut spans the end of an ASR-recognized بام plus a separate بن activity, matching the owner's 'bambun' report. Spectral onset at 40.045 seconds and silence beginning at 40.27 isolate the latter activity as a possible replacement excerpt.
repairs.replacementReason: Replacement excerpt, not a trim: the old start is inside the wrong preceding utterance. Owner must verify that the short isolated activity is بٌ with a complete ب onset and nasal ending.
